nodes.label: Adaptive Browser Coach
nodes.rationale: The browser agent supplies personalized judgement and teaching that a fixed puzzle site cannot provide.

nodes.label: Agent-Driven Gamification
nodes.rationale: XP and badge awards remain coaching judgements rather than fixed rules.

nodes.label: Next Dev Agent File Generator
nodes.rationale: The generated instruction block should remain committed because next dev will recreate it if removed.

nodes.label: Next.js 16 Agent Rules
nodes.rationale: The repository warns that this Next.js version has breaking API, convention, and file-structure changes, so agents must consult the installed documentation before editing code.

nodes.label: ChessUp Devpost Submission
nodes.rationale: The submission frames ChessUp as a personalized coaching collaboration in which deterministic application logic and agent judgement have separate responsibilities.

nodes.label: Deterministic App and Agent Judgement Split
nodes.norm_label: deterministic app and agent judgement split
nodes.rationale: The application handles legality, validation, and cheap tactical heuristics, while the agent handles explanation, plans, and coaching judgement.

nodes.label: Informative Tool Errors
nodes.rationale: Returning legal alternatives and exact puzzle breakpoints lets the agent recover from invalid generated moves.

nodes.label: Engine-Free Auto-Analysis
nodes.rationale: Cheap chess.js heuristics handle deterministic tactical checks while the agent supplies higher-level positional judgement.

nodes.label: Human-Agent Chess Collaboration
nodes.rationale: The student retains control of their pieces while agent outputs arrive through hints, annotations, lesson updates, and rewards.

nodes.label: Human-Controlled Chess
nodes.rationale: The human plays every move and can use the board without an agent, preserving student agency.

nodes.label: Personalized Generated Puzzles
nodes.rationale: The agent composes positions from profile weaknesses so puzzles are individualized rather than generic.

nodes.label: Validated Puzzle Contract
nodes.rationale: Legality validation catches hallucinated solution lines before the student sees them.

nodes.label: Puzzle Rush on Demand
nodes.rationale: Generated FEN positions target the player's recorded weak spots instead of serving generic puzzles.

nodes.label: set_position
nodes.rationale: The app validates generated solution lines before display to catch hallucinated or illegal puzzles.

nodes.label: ChessUp
nodes.rationale: ChessUp deliberately contains no agent AI; it exposes deterministic board capabilities to the browser's existing agent so the human remains the player while the agent observes, teaches, adapts, and rewards.

nodes.label: Agent Activity Panel
nodes.rationale: Showing every tool call and result makes the agent's actions transparent to the human.

nodes.label: Player Event Queue
nodes.rationale: Events since the last agent call prevent brittle history diffing and preserve player actions between pull-based calls.

nodes.label: Read-Only Tool Annotations
nodes.rationale: readOnlyHint marks observational tools so the agent can poll them safely.

nodes.label: wait_for_player_move
nodes.rationale: A long-running call bridges WebMCP's pull model so the agent can continue a game without requiring the human to type after every move.
